name: panama-itbms
description: Use this skill for Panama's goods and services tax (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios, ITBMS) in 2026. It gives the 7% general rate, 10% on alcoholic drinks and on lodging, 15% on tobacco, the exemptions DGI lists (medicines, basic school supplies, uniforms, textbooks, food, farm products, electricity and water, medical and laboratory services), the B/.36,000 annual turnover at which a business must charge ITBMS, input credit, the 50% ITBMS credit against income tax for non-contributors, retention agents, the monthly return in the first 15 days and DGI fines. Trigger phrases include ITBMS Panama, impuesto de transferencia, 7% ITBMS, certificado de no contribuyente, formulario 430 and agente de retencion ITBMS.
